lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible in a grid-like arrangement posterior to the gill area, featuring approximately four distinct vertical columns with 3-5 spots per column on the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with horizontal rows of circular spots, forming distinct anchor nodes across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge and localized shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of small-diameter high-luminance spots that are notably smaller and more closely packed than those on the lateral flank.
